# Credits

<!-- Generated by code/web/scripts/generate-credits.mjs from the dependency files. Do not edit by hand. -->

Lotties is free software under the [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE), and it stands on the work of many people and public institutions. Thank you to every author, maintainer and contributor listed here.

The same list is in the app: <https://lotties.app/credits> (before sign-in) and Hub > App > Credits and licenses.

> Naming a source, service or project here credits it. It does not mean that it endorses, reviewed or is affiliated with Lotties.

## Data and services

### Data sources

| Name | Used for | License or terms |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Anvisa and CMED open data](https://dados.anvisa.gov.br/dados/) | The official medicine list (names, forms and active ingredients), from Anvisa open data and the CMED price list. Not reviewed by a pharmacist. | [Brazilian open data (Decree 8.777/2016): credit the source](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2015-2018/2016/decreto/d8777.htm) |
| [Calendário Nacional de Vacinação (Ministério da Saúde, PNI)](https://www.gov.br/saude/pt-br/vacinacao/calendario) | The Brazilian National Immunization Program schedule. Lotties shows facts (which vaccine, at what age, how many doses), reorganized in our own words, not the original document. Content published by the Ministry of Health under CC BY-ND 3.0. | [CC BY-ND 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/3.0/deed.pt_BR) |
| [Sociedade Brasileira de Pediatria (SBP)](https://www.sbp.com.br/) | A reference for the vaccine schedule recommended by pediatricians. Only scheduling facts are used, with attribution. No endorsement or affiliation is claimed. | All rights reserved (only facts are used, with attribution) |
| [Sociedade Brasileira de Imunizações (SBIm)](https://sbim.org.br/) | A reference for the vaccine schedule of the immunization society. Only scheduling facts are used, with attribution. No endorsement or affiliation is claimed. | All rights reserved (only facts are used, with attribution) |
| [Infant sleep norms: National Sleep Foundation (2015), American Academy of Sleep Medicine (2016), SBP (2025), Galland et al. (2012), Iglowstein et al. (2003), Pelotas 2004 Birth Cohort (Netsi et al. 2017)](https://github.com/lotties-app/lotties.app/blob/main/docs/design/28-age-norms.md) | Published sleep durations, night wakings and bed and wake times by age. Only the numbers are used, as starting points for predictions before a baby has enough logs of her own. No endorsement or affiliation is claimed. | [Pelotas cohort CC BY 4.0; the others all rights reserved (only facts are used, with attribution)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| [Infant feeding norms: SBP Manual de Alimentação (2024), Ministério da Saúde Guia alimentar (2019), AAP HealthyChildren, Academy of Breastfeeding Medicine, Kent et al. (2006), MILQ Study (2025), WHO](https://github.com/lotties-app/lotties.app/blob/main/docs/design/28-age-norms.md) | Published feeds a day, gaps and milk amounts by age. Only the numbers are used, for example for the first bottle amount chips; never as a target. No endorsement or affiliation is claimed. | [MILQ Study CC BY 4.0; the others all rights reserved or site terms (only facts are used, with attribution)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| [Diaper and crying norms: UNICEF UK Baby Friendly checklist (via NHS), den Hertog et al. (2012), HELMi cohort (2024), Wolke et al. (2017)](https://github.com/lotties-app/lotties.app/blob/main/docs/design/28-age-norms.md) | Published diaper counts, stools and crying time by age. Only the numbers are recorded, as context for the design of the predictions; never as an alert. | [HELMi cohort CC BY 4.0; the others all rights reserved (only facts are used, with attribution)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| [OpenStreetMap contributors](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) | Map and address data behind the address search for doctors and clinics. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors. | [ODbL 1.0](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/) |
| [AudioSet ontology (Google)](https://research.google.com/audioset/ontology/index.html) | The audio class names inside the YAMNet model come from the AudioSet ontology (CC BY-SA 4.0); the Cry monitor reads its "Baby cry, infant cry" class. | [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) |

### Services we call

| Name | Used for | License or terms |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Nominatim (OpenStreetMap Foundation)](https://nominatim.org/) | The place search used when you look up a clinic or address by text. Our server asks it, so your device and account are not sent. | [GPL-2.0 (software); results are OpenStreetMap data (ODbL)](https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/) |
| [BrasilAPI](https://brasilapi.com.br/) | Looks up an address from a Brazilian postal code (CEP). | [MIT](https://github.com/BrasilAPI/BrasilAPI/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [ViaCEP](https://viacep.com.br/) | The fallback for postal code (CEP) lookups. | Free public service |

### Platforms and standards

| Name | Used for | License or terms |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Keycloak](https://www.keycloak.org/) | Sign-in and accounts (OpenID Connect identity provider). | [Apache-2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0) |
| [Keycloakify](https://www.keycloakify.dev/) | The sign-in pages are themed with Keycloakify. | [MIT](https://github.com/keycloakify/keycloakify/blob/main/LICENSE) |

| [Vite, Vitest, TypeScript, ESLint and Prettier](https://vite.dev/) | The tools that build and test the app. They are used while building and are not part of what runs on your phone. | MIT, Apache-2.0 (TypeScript) |
| [Web Push and VAPID (IETF RFC 8030, 8291 and 8292)](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8292) | Reminders reach your phone through the open Web Push standard with VAPID keys, sent by our own server (no third-party push service SDK). | Open standards |
